computers.q: I'm not great with computers. Can I use this?
computers.a: Yes. It was designed for busy agents: big text, clear buttons and one step at a time. If you can fill in a form, you can use RealtyBoost.

accuracy.q: Will the AI make things up about the house?
accuracy.a: It writes only from the facts you enter, and we tell it never to invent features. You should still read everything before you use it — you're the expert.

posting.q: Does it post to my social media for me?
posting.a: Not yet. You copy and paste with one click, so you stay in control of what goes out.

privacy.q: Who can see my clients and listings?
privacy.a: Only you (and teammates on a Team plan). Your data is kept separate from every other account.

cancel.a: Yes. There are no contracts. Cancel from your billing page in two clicks.

languages.q: Can it write the same listing in two languages?
languages.a: Yes. Tick more than one language and you'll get each version side by side.
